verdict.rationale: Zero is open source and explicitly markets self-hosting, with documented setup steps (env setup, devcontainer, `pnpm go`). However, mail still flows through external providers such as Gmail via Google OAuth, and storage relies on Durable Objects and R2 buckets. Self-hosting also still appears as a ROADMAP item, so the 'keep the mail pipeline under my own control' part is only weakly supported. Missing for 10: production self-hosting deployment docs, a provider-independent mail pipeline (own IMAP/SMTP or mail server control), clarity on running storage without external cloud services, and hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted setup.
